actual_call_path.observation: Strict registered-module command selection validates an unresolved target on the same binding generation and requires registered recovery support before returning a RuntimeCommand.
Startup opens and recovers the journal before polling module.next; each returned RuntimeCommand is scope-checked and dispatched to handle_command, then pending messages are flushed.

handle_reconcile checks target binding, generation, native scope, and route; successful native evidence creates a linked target outcome and a distinct reconcile summary. NativeClient.get uses HTTP GET. This path contains no native mutation replay.

Only an exact linked Unknown-to-Applied successor passes; a missing old slot is allowed only when the predecessor is acknowledged; an occupied slot can be replaced only when its bytes are the exact Unknown predecessor of the durable latest Applied revision. Restart republishes the exact latest unacknowledged revision.

Flush sends module.outcome, appends ACK for that payload digest, removes the pending slot, and defers a resolved reconcile summary until the target's current Applied digest is ACKed. Store validates exact admitted reconcile/target IDs, binding generation, target eligibility, and native_replay=false before recording the linked target outcome.

findings.title: Strict Store command selection blocks the adapter's exact agent.reply readback path
findings.trigger: A supported OpenCode agent.reply native reply may have taken effect but its outcome is Unknown; a caller invokes public agent.reconcile for that exact Operation, binding, and generation.
causal_path: The public catalog describes agent.reconcile as resolving one operation's unknown outcome by readback only (mcp_catalog.rs:1625-1629); the OpenCode module contract also forbids replay and requires exact reply request identity/fingerprint (module-contract-v2.md:129-131).

The strict registered-module command-selection path checks the target through registered_module_recovery_contract (runtime.rs:1541-1563). That helper returns None for any target method except agent.open, task.dispatch, or agent.send (operations.rs:952-960). The queued reconciliation cannot be returned by module.next to the adapter.

The OpenCode adapter nevertheless contains an exact agent.reply readback branch (lib.rs:1985-1992; native_interactions.rs:259-352), so durable native reply evidence cannot resolve this admitted Operation through the current public Store path. The selected-module Store outcome validator uses the same recovery-contract gate (runtime.rs:2468-2489).
findings.impact: The caller may have an admitted reconcile Operation, but the adapter never receives it; the original reply remains outcome_unknown even when exact native history could prove it. This is a bounded recovery gap and does not authorize replay.
findings.minimal_repair: Align strict Store admission and linked-outcome validation with the adapter's exact reply readback, gated by the retained descriptor and saved request identity/fingerprint. Emit and validate reply-specific readback evidence; applied_from_intent currently maps None evidence to native_session_created/exact_session_readback (lib.rs:2097-2149).
findings.confidence: high for the strict registered-module route; no native or Store consumer execution was performed

qualification_limits: The linked-reconcile fixtures construct typed intents/outcomes and exercise journal recovery plus a fake Store sender; they do not invoke handle_reconcile, Store::call, or a native server.
Fixtures were inspected as source only and were not executed.
